text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $81k while Ethereum has softened slightly to $2,408, suggesting cautious divergence between the two majors as Ethereum underperforms. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 55 but has retreated 9 points over the week, signaling sentiment is cooling from recent optimism despite elevated trading volume of $169b. Bitcoin's 59.4% dominance indicates the market remains concentrated in the largest asset, though the broader altcoin weakness hints at risk-off positioning among secondary assets.
